verdict.rationale: RevenueCat can send real-time event notifications via webhooks and run scheduled data exports, so events can drive automation. However, there is no evidence of an in-product rules engine for defining conditions and triggering actions; users must build that logic themselves on top of the webhooks. A community feature request for timed hooks, such as trial-expiry reminders, suggests rule-based actions were not native at that time. Missing for 10: a native rule/condition builder, built-in automated actions triggered by events, time-based triggers, and any hands-on corroboration.
